log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY (from day 1). Kill quick entries in the AFTERNOON only, so L's routine filter keeps night, student and home routines (pool factor 0.55, about 55000). National-TV kills are always safe. My kinds and places: regional=East, sector=hospital, age=radio, forum, foreign. L can reach exactly 3 of the 5 kinds. If he fully learns all 3 reachable kinds, the pool falls to 55000*0.25^3=859 (or 688 if sector is one of them), which is <=1000, so I am CAUGHT. If he learns only 2, the pool stays at about 2750-3400, which is SAFE. GOAL: find ONE reachable kind E and NEVER kill from it again. Then kill national plus all 4 other kinds every day = 9 kills/day, which gives x4 once the last-5-day total reaches 40. PROBE METHOD: if a day has 5 or fewer deaths, all of them get traced. A probe day's rise in the traced count shows whether the probed kind is reachable (rise >=1 means reachable; rise 0 means unreachable, so that kind is free to kill). Traces of victims from an unreachable kind always fail, so they add 0 to the count. DAY 1: killed national d1-5 plus hospital d1-1 and d1-8 (3 deaths, all traced). Traced count before day 1 = 0. DAY 2 PLAN: compare the traced count after day 1. If it rose by 1 or more, sector is reachable, so E=sector: never kill hospital again; from day 2 kill national + East + radio + forum + foreign (9/day). If it rose by 0, sector is unreachable (free). On day 2 kill national + 2 hospital + 2 East (5 deaths, all traced) as a probe of regional. If the day-2 rise is >=1, E=regional: from day 3 kill national + hospital + radio + forum + foreign. If the rise is 0, regional is unreachable too, so radio, forum and foreign are all reachable: pick E=forum and from day 3 kill national + hospital + East + radio + foreign. Once E is set, never kill from E. Watch the pool: it should settle around 3000. If it drops below 2000, something is wrong, so cut kills to national only and rethink.
